newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-Signet Banking Q2 loss vs profit.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Signet Banking Q2 loss vs profit.

text.p: NOTE: Results for the 1997 second quarter included a pretax charge of $58.7 million taken in conjunction with the company's previously announced corporate redesign program. Adjusting for the restructuring charge, operating earnings rose 15 percent to $35 million, and earnings per share increased 14 percent to $0.57 over the second quarter of 1996.
The managed loan portfolio, which includes loans and securitized assets, totaled $7.3 billion as of June 30, 1997.
Note: Non-performing assets at June 30, 1997, totaled $33.3 million, or 0.52 percent of loans and foreclosed properties, down from $40.7 million at March 31, 1997, and $54.9 million at June 30, 1996.
